SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTrades, SUM(CASE WHEN profit_rate >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winCount, SUM(CASE WHEN profit_rate < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lossCount, COALESCE(AVG(profit_rate), 0) AS avgProfitRate, COALESCE(SUM(profit_amount), 0) AS totalProfitAmount, COALESCE(MIN(profit_rate), 0) AS worstRate, COALESCE(MAX(profit_rate), 0) AS bestRate FROM trade_execution WHERE bought_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trade_execution_keyword tek WHERE tek.execution_id = trade_execution.id AND tek.keyword = #{keyword} )

SELECT DATE(bought_at) AS tradeDate, COUNT(*) AS tradeCount, COALESCE(SUM(profit_amount), 0) AS profitAmount, COALESCE(AVG(profit_rate), 0) AS avgProfitRate FROM trade_execution WHERE bought_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY DATE(bought_at) ORDER BY DATE(bought_at)

SELECT tek.keyword AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS hitCount, COALESCE(AVG(te.profit_rate), 0) AS avgProfitRate, COALESCE(SUM(te.profit_amount), 0) AS totalProfitAmount FROM trade_execution te JOIN trade_execution_keyword tek ON tek.execution_id = te.id WHERE te.bought_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY tek.keyword ORDER BY totalProfitAmount DESC
